plan.title: Explore dataset structure and statistics
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) number of images, annotations, categories, (2) annotation distribution per image (min/max/mean), (3) category frequency distribution (how many categories have <5, <10, <20 annotations), (4) image sizes, (5) bbox size distribution, (6) how many categories have reference images, (7) category 356 'unknown_product' frequency, (8) sample a few annotations to understand the data format thoroughly.
plan.success_criteria: Complete statistical summary of the dataset logged, understanding of class imbalance and data characteristics

plan.title: YOLOv8m single-class detection baseline at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8m model trained for detection-only (single class) on ~200 training images at 1280px resolution can achieve detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.4, establishing a working baseline pipeline
plan.description: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with single class. Split data ~80/20 train/val. Train YOLOv8m at imgsz=1280 for 100 epochs with default augmentations. Build full inference pipeline that outputs predictions.json in required COCO format. Evaluate detection mAP@0.5. This establishes the end-to-end pipeline.
plan.success_criteria: Working end-to-end pipeline with detection_mAP@0.5 > 0.3 on validation set

plan.title: YOLOv8l multi-class detection at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Training YOLOv8l with all 357 categories directly will provide both detection and classification in one model, potentially achieving final_score > 0.3
plan.description: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with all categories. Train YOLOv8l at 1280px for 150 epochs. Use copy-paste augmentation and mosaic. Evaluate both detection_mAP and classification_mAP. Compare with single-class baseline.
plan.success_criteria: final_score > 0.25 with both detection and classification metrics

plan.title: Two-stage: best detector + embedding-based classification using reference images
plan.hypothesis: Using pretrained DINOv2/CLIP features to match detected crops against reference product images will provide strong classification without needing many per-class training examples
plan.description: Use best detection model to extract crops from training images. Extract features from all reference product images using DINOv2-base (via torch.hub or timm). Build a reference gallery indexed by category_id. At inference: detect -> crop -> extract features -> nearest neighbor match to gallery -> assign category_id. Evaluate classification accuracy and full pipeline score.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over end-to-end YOLO multi-class approach

plan.title: SAHI (sliced inference) for improved small object detection
plan.hypothesis: Running inference on overlapping tiles and merging with NMS/WBF will improve detection of small products on dense shelves, boosting detection_mAP by 5-10%
plan.description: Implement SAHI-style sliced inference: split test images into overlapping 640x640 tiles, run detection on each tile, merge predictions with WBF. Also try training on tiles. Compare detection mAP with full-image approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement of at least 0.03 over best full-image model

plan.title: Fine-tune embedding classifier with contrastive learning on crop-reference pairs
plan.hypothesis: Fine-tuning the embedding model with contrastive loss on (crop, reference) pairs will improve retrieval-based classification by 10%+
plan.description: Create training pairs from annotated crops and reference images. Fine-tune DINOv2/CLIP with contrastive/triplet loss. Use hard negative mining. Evaluate retrieval accuracy on validation crops.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improvement of 10%+ over zero-shot retrieval

plan.title: Ensemble detection + optimized classification pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Combining best detection approach (possibly ensemble of models or SAHI) with best classifier will maximize final_score
plan.description: Assemble final pipeline: best detection model/ensemble + best classification approach. Tune confidence thresholds. Handle unknown_product category (use embedding distance threshold). Optimize for 300s inference budget. Profile and ensure fits within time limit.
plan.success_criteria: final_score improvement over any individual approach

plan.title: Final optimization: TTA, threshold tuning, inference speed
plan.hypothesis: Test-time augmentation and careful threshold tuning can squeeze out additional 2-5% improvement
plan.description: Add TTA (horizontal flip, multi-scale) if time budget allows. Tune detection confidence threshold and NMS IoU threshold on validation set. Ensure model weights fit in 420MB limit. Verify inference runs within 300s on L4 GPU. Handle edge cases.
plan.success_criteria: Maximized final_score within all competition constraints
